主要内容: Internet America Inc has authorized the Board of Directors to take steps to deregister from the reporting requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, due to having less than 300 shareholders of record. The company plans to file a Form 15 with the Securities and Exchange Commission on July 1, 2015, to deregister its common stock under Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act and suspend its reporting requirements under Sections 13(a) and 15(d) of the Exchange Act. The filing is expected to be completed on the same date.
